summary_markdown:
The conversation focused on database schema changes. [p1] questioned the purpose of a specific table creation (`v_device_session_agg_campaign_avg_prod_test`) and its use in production versus staging environments.

Later, it was noted that an existing view had added parameters, causing incompatibility with current calls. The team discussed whether to implement A/B testing for the switch or simply update during deployment. It was decided to proceed with a quick update during deployment due to low traffic and minimal downtime (1-2 minutes).

Finally, [p1] raised concerns about merging code changes, noting that some fixes were in the release branch but missing from development, potentially causing conflicts and data loss.
decisions: The view incompatibility will be resolved by updating during deployment due to low traffic.
action_items: Someone needs more time for the merge process due to conflicting fixes between branches.
